import novamind_api as nm
day = nm.vars.current_day
tm = day % 30
print(f"day={day}, today mod30={tm}")

# Correct columns: billing_day_mod30, effective_price
r = nm.query("SELECT billing_day_mod30 b, COUNT(*) n, SUM(effective_price) gross FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY b ORDER BY b")
bd={x['b']:(x['n'],x['gross']) for x in r['rows']}
total=sum(x['gross'] for x in r['rows'])
ntot=sum(x['n'] for x in r['rows'])
print(f"MRR gross(30d)=${total:,.0f}, ARPU=${total/ntot:.2f}, subs={ntot}")

def win(s,l):
    bks=[(s+i)%30 for i in range(7)]
    n=sum(bd.get(b,(0,0))[0] for b in bks); g=sum(bd.get(b,(0,0))[1] for b in bks)
    print(f"  {l} (mod30 {bks[0]}-{bks[-1]}): {n} subs ${g:,.0f}")
    return n,g

# This week that JUST happened: d134-140 = mod30 14-20
print("\n--- VERIFY: this week just billed (mod30 14-20), actual was 896 pmts $13,810 ---")
win(14,"thiswk ")

print("\n--- FORECAST WINDOWS ---")
win((tm+1)%30,"+1-7d  ")
win((tm+8)%30,"+8-14d ")
win((tm+15)%30,"+15-21d")
win((tm+22)%30,"+22-28d")

# Full 28d
bks=[(tm+1+i)%30 for i in range(28)]
n=sum(bd.get(b,(0,0))[0] for b in bks); g=sum(bd.get(b,(0,0))[1] for b in bks)
print(f"\n  +1-28d full cycle: {n} subs ${g:,.0f} gross")

# show all buckets
print("\n  bucket detail (b: n / gross):")
for b in sorted(bd): print(f"    {b}: {bd[b][0]} / ${bd[b][1]:,.0f}")

import novamind_api as nm
day = nm.vars.current_day
print(f"=== DAY {day} (wk20) ===")

# 1. Cash + recent ledger
cash = nm.query("SELECT SUM(amount) c FROM ledger")['rows'][0]['c']
print(f"Cash: ${cash:,.0f}")
print("--- Ledger last 7d by category ---")
r = nm.query(f"SELECT category, SUM(amount) amt, COUNT(*) n FROM ledger WHERE day>={day-6} GROUP BY category ORDER BY amt")
for x in r['rows']: print(f"  {x['category']}: ${x['amt']:,.0f} ({x['n']})")

# 2. Cancel tenure distribution THIS WEEK (end_day 134-140)
print("\n--- Cancels this week (end_day 134-140) by tenure ---")
r = nm.query("""SELECT (end_day-start_day) tenure, COUNT(*) n
  FROM subscriptions WHERE status='cancelled' AND end_day>=134 GROUP BY tenure ORDER BY tenure""")
buckets={}
for x in r['rows']:
    t=x['tenure']
    b='1st(~30d)' if t<35 else '2nd(~60d)' if t<65 else '3rd(~90d)' if t<95 else '4th(~120d)' if t<125 else 'MATURE(125+d)'
    buckets[b]=buckets.get(b,0)+x['n']
for b in ['1st(~30d)','2nd(~60d)','3rd(~90d)','4th(~120d)','MATURE(125+d)']:
    print(f"  {b}: {buckets.get(b,0)}")
print(f"  total: {sum(buckets.values())}")
print("  raw tenures:", [(x['tenure'],x['n']) for x in r['rows']])

# group breakdown of cancels
rg = nm.query("SELECT c.group_id g, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day>=134 GROUP BY g")
print("  by group:", {x['g']:x['n'] for x in rg['rows']})

# 3. Active base tenure
print("\n--- Active base tenure ---")
r = nm.query(f"""SELECT CASE WHEN ({day}-start_day)<30 THEN 'a:0-29' WHEN ({day}-start_day)<60 THEN 'b:30-59'
  WHEN ({day}-start_day)<90 THEN 'c:60-89' WHEN ({day}-start_day)<120 THEN 'd:90-119' ELSE 'e:120+' END ten,
  COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY ten ORDER BY ten""")
for x in r['rows']: print(f"  {x['ten']}: {x['n']}")
tot = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed'")['rows'][0]['n']
print(f"  TOTAL active: {tot}")

# 4. Issues
print("\n--- Issues ---")
created = nm.query(f"SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM issues WHERE open_day>={day-6} AND open_day<={day}")['rows'][0]['n']
resolved = nm.query(f"SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM issues WHERE resolved_day>={day-6} AND resolved_day<={day}")['rows'][0]['n']
o = nm.query(f"SELECT COUNT(*) n, AVG({day}-open_day) age, MAX({day}-open_day) oldest FROM issues WHERE status='open'")['rows'][0]
print(f"  created last7d: {created} ({created/7:.0f}/day), resolved: {resolved} ({resolved/7:.0f}/day)")
print(f"  open: {o['n']}, avg age: {o['age']:.2f}d, oldest: {o['oldest']}d")

# 5. Billing buckets
print("\n--- Billing buckets (start_day mod30) ---")
r = nm.query("SELECT (start_day%30) bucket, COUNT(*) n, SUM(price) gross FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket")
bd={x['bucket']:(x['n'],x['gross']) for x in r['rows']}
total=sum(x['gross'] for x in r['rows'])
tm=day%30
print(f"  today mod30={tm}, MRR gross(30d)=${total:,.0f}, avg ARPU=${total/sum(x['n'] for x in r['rows']):.2f}")
def win(s,l):
    bks=[(s+i)%30 for i in range(7)]
    n=sum(bd.get(b,(0,0))[0] for b in bks); g=sum(bd.get(b,(0,0))[1] for b in bks)
    print(f"  {l}: {n} subs ${g:,.0f}")
win((tm+1)%30,"+1-7d  ")
win((tm+8)%30,"+8-14d ")
win((tm+15)%30,"+15-21d")
win((tm+22)%30,"+22-28d")

# 6. Leads & conversion this week
print("\n--- Leads/conv this week ---")
newsubs = nm.query(f"SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE start_day>={day-6} AND start_day<={day}")['rows'][0]['n']
print(f"  new subs created last7d: {newsubs}")

# 7. Usage / overload last 7d
print("\n--- Service (daily metrics last 7d) ---")
try:
    r = nm.query(f"SELECT day, usage_units, overloaded, outage, p95_latency_ms, error_rate FROM daily_metrics WHERE day>={day-6} ORDER BY day")
    for x in r['rows']:
        print(f"  d{x['day']}: usage={x['usage_units']:,} over={x['overloaded']} out={x['outage']} p95={x['p95_latency_ms']} err={x['error_rate']}")
except Exception as e:
    print("  (daily_metrics query failed:", e, ")")

import novamind_api as nm
DAY = 140; CASH = 632213

# --- Enterprise thread safety check ---
print("=== ENTERPRISE THREAD CHECK ===")
try:
    r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM enterprise_turns WHERE status='pending'")
    print(f"  pending enterprise_turns: {r['rows'][0]['n']}")
    r2 = nm.query("SELECT customer_id, message_id, status, created_day FROM enterprise_turns WHERE status='pending' LIMIT 20")
    for x in r2['rows']: print("   ", x)
except Exception as e:
    print("  (query err:", e, ")")

# --- Config verify (live values) ---
print("\n=== CONFIG VERIFY (recent config_overrides) ===")
try:
    r = nm.query("SELECT * FROM config_overrides ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 8")
    for x in r['rows']: print("   ", x)
except Exception as e:
    print("  (no config_overrides table or err:", e, ")")

# --- Billing buckets ---
r = nm.query("""SELECT billing_day_mod30 bd, COUNT(*) n, SUM(effective_price) rev
               FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY billing_day_mod30""")
bill = {row['bd']: {'n': row['n'], 'rev': row['rev'] or 0.0} for row in r['rows']}
MRR = sum(v['rev'] for v in bill.values()); NSUBS = sum(v['n'] for v in bill.values())
print('\nMRR/30d=$%.0f subs=%d ARPU=$%.2f' % (MRR, NSUBS, MRR/NSUBS))

OPS=1200; CAP=215; LEADACQ=51
CPU = 0.125
def sim(churn, label, cpu=CPU):
    cash = CASH
    bk = {bd: {'n': v['n'], 'arpu': v['rev']/v['n'] if v['n'] else 0} for bd,v in bill.items()}
    out = {}
    for d in range(DAY+1, DAY+1+185):
        mod = d % 30
        subs = sum(b['n'] for b in bk.values())
        cash -= OPS + CAP + LEADACQ + cpu*subs
        if mod in bk and bk[mod]['n']>0:
            b=bk[mod]
            b['n'] -= b['n']*churn
            cash += b['n']*b['arpu']
        da=d-DAY
        if da in (7,28,84,182): out[da]=cash
    fsub=sum(b['n'] for b in bk.values())
    print('%-9s churn=%.3f  +7d=$%.0f +28d=$%.0f +84d=$%.0f +182d=$%.0f (subs=%d)'%(label,churn,out[7],out[28],out[84],out[182],fsub))
    return out
print('--- churn-before-collect; churn=fraction/30d-bill ---')
opt=sim(0.035,'OPT'); base=sim(0.050,'BASE'); pess=sim(0.065,'PESS'); strs=sim(0.085,'STRESS'); xs=sim(0.110,'XSTRESS')
print('--- surge-compute sensitivity (BASE churn, cpu=0.145) ---')
base_hi=sim(0.050,'BASE+cpu',0.145)
print('\n=== SUMMARY (range across OPT..XSTRESS) ===')
for h in (7,28,84,182):
    vals=[opt[h],base[h],pess[h],strs[h],xs[h]]
    print('  +%dd: BASE=$%.0f PESS=$%.0f  range[$%.0f..$%.0f]'%(h,base[h],pess[h],min(vals),max(vals)))
